note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Links are supplied by the author: a solid thread is a link supplied as direct support, a dashed thread a link supplied as a disputed inference (neutral dispute marker). Nothing weighs evidence, judges credibility or applies a proof standard. Editable brief fields: claims, evidence, links, uncertainties, actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations, finalState.
